fieldValues.title: You write, your AI supports
fieldValues.summary: An essay editor where AI can critique, question and research your work, but can't write a word of it. The AI advises and assists; every word is yours, so the meaning stays yours.
fieldValues.explanation: This editor keeps you in charge of your own meaning and gives the AI a way to support you: it advises beside your text, and only you write in it.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Your role here is to advise and assist the writer: critique, question, suggest structure, research, validate and highlight. Every word of the essay is the writer's; leave every sentence to the human.
